assumptions.statement: Hostile same-user races, operating-system and executable trust, cache provenance, and parent pin enforcement remain external-host responsibilities.
assumptions.rationale: Repository code can enforce location and byte checks without claiming host isolation.

assumptions.statement: The integration owner retains independent review, V11 refresh, successor gate, R2, hosted CI, and merge authority.
assumptions.rationale: The correction producer cannot approve its own release.

assumptions.statement: Revision 17-19 producer and independent-review evidence remains immutable; Revision 20 creates a new package and source identity.
assumptions.rationale: A correction must preserve every prior attempt and verdict.

assumptions.statement: Candidate, parent, cache declaration, and canonical-gate bytes define stable reconstruction; owner and handoff values define phase authority only.
assumptions.rationale: Authority must not redefine the package it authorizes.
